rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and prior ZIP via the tool, then requested full new address before making any profile changes, complying with authentication and write-confirmation policy. The user declined to provide the address, so no write occurred—appropriately avoiding unauthorized changes. For the product inquiry, the agent used tools to list and fetch T‑Shirt details and correctly identified the cheapest available variant ($46.66, red L v‑neck). When the user asked to order, the agent correctly required a shipping address and payment method and did not proceed without them. The agent also correctly stated that only physical products are available and provided accurate Bluetooth speaker and jigsaw puzzle options with prices supported by the tools. No fabricated information, no unconfirmed writes, and no action on another account occurred. While the address update was not completed due to user choice, the agent acted fully within policy and completed the feasible parts of the request.
